name: aspec
description: Initialize AgentSpec repositories and continue AgentSpec work from Codex using CLI-backed skills for status, tasks, drift, and manual source intake.

interface.shortDescription: Run AgentSpec workflows from Codex without bypassing repo governance.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex skills that invoke the AgentSpec CLI to initialize new or existing repositories, continue ready AgentSpec work, inspect project status, create task context packs, run drift review, and import manual or host-provided external-source content. The plugin does not own parsing, diffing, promotion, credentials, or accepted snapshots.
defaultPrompt: Import this design export as a candidate.
